cardOverview.overviewText: The DCB PayLess Select Credit Card is a secured RuPay credit card backed by your DCB Bank fixed deposit, offering a higher credit limit and quarterly cashback rewards when you meet set spend milestones, along with perks like fuel surcharge waivers and personal accident cover.

items.title: Discover Reward Points Redemption Options
items.subtitle: To explore the full range of redemption options for this card, download the SaveSage Club app now.
